title: Enforced state
description: What an enforcer read back for one device. Null means unknown and is a value, never an omission.

locked.description: True when the enforcer can see the device is stopped, false when it can see it is not, null when it does not know. Never guess.

in_use.description: True only when the enforcer knows the device is being used now. The controller charges minutes on it for devices with no usage API.

detail.description: Human text shown in summaries, such as 'client blocked' or 'waiting for a parent to lock'.

observed_at.description: RFC 3339 with an explicit offset (Z or +hh:mm).
